disorder-name.detail: Clinical High Risk for Psychosis; individuals meeting CHR-P criteria according to CAARMS or SIPS. HC group serves as normative reference; CHR-P individuals are the clinical cohort to which the normative modelling (Normative PBSI) was applied.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "using a normative modelling approach, to assess the 'normativeness' of neuroanatomical profiles in individuals at CHR-P"

dataset-of-origin.detail: ENIGMA CHR-P consortium dataset; 29 international sites pooled.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The ENIGMA CHR-P consortium applied a harmonised analysis to neuroimaging data across 29 international sites, including 1579 CHR-P individuals and 1243 HC"

age.detail: Mean age and SD for the CHR-P clinical cohort (N=1579). Age min/max not reported.
age.supporting_text: "the final sample consisted of 1 579 CHR-P participants (mean age = 20.63 [SD = 4.60], 47.37% females)"

sex.detail: Male and female counts from Table 1 (831 M / 748 F, total N=1579). Female percentage (47.37%) directly reported in Results text; male percentage derived as 100 − 47.37 = 52.63% ≈ 52.6%.
sex.location: Baldwin2022.pdf.md: Table 1 / Sample characteristics, L70; Results / Sample characteristics, L114
